description: This source file implements middleware functions for authentication and tenant-based access control in a Node.js server environment, specifically for handling JWT tokens, enforcing tenant access, and applying tenant filters to database queries.

methods.name: authTenant
methods.description: Middleware to authenticate requests using JWT, verify token claims, and attach user/tenant info to the request object.

methods.name: ensureTenantAccess
methods.description: Middleware to ensure the tenant ID in request parameters matches the authenticated tenant, enforcing tenant isolation.

methods.name: applyTenantFilter
methods.description: Helper function to add tenant filtering logic to MongoDB queries or filter objects, preventing cross-tenant data leakage.
